name: nephis-mcp-server
description: Sub-6ms hardware KVM MicroVM sandboxes, 30ms zero-copy PostgreSQL branching, and sub-38ms online code judging for AI coding agents.

tools.name: thanaton_spawn_sandbox
tools.description: Spawn a sub-6ms hardware KVM microVM with isolated vCPU, RAM, and disk for untrusted code execution.

tools.name: thanaton_exec_command
tools.description: Execute shell commands inside an isolated microVM sandbox with real-time stdout/stderr streaming.

tools.name: thanaton_run_code
tools.description: Execute code snippets in Python, Node.js, C++, Rust, Go, or Bash inside a dedicated microVM.

tools.name: mnemon_create_branch
tools.description: Create an instant (<31ms) zero-copy Copy-on-Write PostgreSQL 16 database branch from any parent branch.

tools.name: mnemon_execute_sql
tools.description: Execute interactive SQL queries directly against any branch or database instance.

tools.name: eschaton_fast_batch
tools.description: Execute 50-testcase algorithmic batches in parallel with sub-38ms latency (Judge0 drop-in).

tools.name: nephis_whoami
tools.description: Introspect active developer tenant, trial credit balance, rate limits, and API keys.
